description: This is a PHP unit test class for the LeaveOverlapAPI in the OrangeHRM project, testing API endpoints related to leave overlap checks in the leave module.

classes.name: LeaveOverlapAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for the LeaveOverlapAPI, extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase to test various API methods and validation rules related to leave overlap functionality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test fixtures by populating leave balance data from YAML configuration before each test.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete operation on LeaveOverlapAPI throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the delete API endpoint, expecting a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests that the create operation on LeaveOverlapAPI throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the create API endpoint, expecting a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates various query parameter validation rules for fetching all leave overlaps, including date range and access control.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Data-driven test to verify the getAll API endpoint returns expected results with different parameter sets.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the getAll API tests, sourced from a YAML file.
